title: Add the auth module
description: Copy the auth module (core service/interceptor for the chosen strategy, storage seam, forms) into an existing project, add the chosen auth layout (via foundation:layout), and wire the `auth` route branch.

authType.description: Which auth strategy's service + interceptor to copy. 'jwt' — access/refresh token pair, Authorization header, one-shot 401 refresh-and-retry. 'session' — opaque session id echoed as X-Session-Id, no refresh concept.

storeType.description: Where auth tokens live. 'local' — localStorage, survives reload, XSS-readable. 'memory' — in-memory only, recommended for production paired with a server-set HttpOnly refresh cookie.

authLayout.description: Which auth layout shell to add (foundation:layout's auth-split or auth-centered catalog entry). Distinct from foundation's own `layout` option — this picks the shell that wraps ONLY the auth route branch, not the main app shell.
